text.description_html:
4 1/2" x 4" x Square Corners Commercial Door Hinge

For commercial doors. Heavy duty steel commercial grade door hinge with 2 ball bearings.

Secure Non-Removable Pin for exterior outswing doors, prevents the hinge pins removal by vandals and thieves.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Non-Removable Pin for Security
  • US26D Brushed Chrome Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Button Tip Pin and Plug
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws and 12 x 1-1/4" wood screws.

*Sold Individually
